record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.original_question: Let f be a germ of a real-analytic symplectic diffeomorphism of R^{2n} fixing the origin, with linear part conjugate in Sp(2n,R) to a product of planar rotations with Diophantine frequency vector α. Must every sufficiently small neighborhood of 0 contain a positive-Lebesgue-measure set of invariant Lagrangian tori for f?

evidence.quote: If f is real analytic, then f leaves invariant, in any small neighbourhood of 0, a set of positive Lebesgue measure of Lagrangian tori .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let n ≥ 1 and let f : (R^{2n}, 0) → (R^{2n}, 0) be the germ of a real-analytic diffeomorphism that fixes the origin and preserves the standard symplectic form on R^{2n}. Assume the linear part Df(0) is conjugate, inside the symplectic group Sp(2n, R), to a product of planar rotations

  R_{α_1} ⊕ R_{α_2} ⊕ … ⊕ R_{α_n},

where R_θ denotes rotation by angle 2π θ in R^2, and the frequency vector α = (α_1, …, α_n) ∈ R^n is Diophantine: there exist constants C > 0 and τ > 0 such that

  | k · α − m | ≥ C |k|^{−τ}   for every k ∈ Z^n \ {0} and every m ∈ Z.

A Lagrangian torus invariant under f is an embedded n-dimensional torus T ⊂ R^{2n} such that f(T) = T and the standard symplectic form vanishes on TT.

Question: Is it true that for every such f and every sufficiently small neighborhood U of 0 in R^{2n}, the union of all f-invariant Lagrangian tori contained in U has positive Lebesgue measure in R^{2n}?
artifact.category_tag: KAM theory at elliptic fixed points
artifact.status_search_result: This is a version of Herman's elliptic fixed point conjecture (the discrete/symplectic-diffeomorphism analogue). Eliasson, Fayad, and Krikorian (2014) proved accumulation by complex-analytic KAM tori at a Diophantine elliptic fixed point and obtained the positive-measure conclusion under a Rüssmann-type non-degeneracy of the Birkhoff normal form, but the general conjecture (without any non-degeneracy assumption on the Birkhoff normal form) remains open as of the most recent literature found.

status_evidence.title: KAM-tori near an analytic elliptic fixed point (Eliasson, Fayad, Krikorian)
status_evidence.snippet: A Diophantine elliptic fixed point of a real-analytic Hamiltonian is accumulated by complex-analytic KAM-tori; positive Lebesgue measure of real KAM-tori is obtained under a Rüssmann transversality condition on the Birkhoff normal form.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results: positive measure proved under a non-degeneracy condition on the Birkhoff normal form; degenerate case yields only complex-analytic tori, so the general conjecture remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Herman conjecture (Fayad–Krikorian)
status_evidence.snippet: Herman conjectured that an elliptic equilibrium with Diophantine frequency vector must be accumulated by a set of positive measure of KAM tori; the article addresses this conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture, in its full generality (no Birkhoff non-degeneracy hypothesis), is referred to as still open.
